WITH member_sums AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS member_total
    FROM income
    WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_member
), shares AS (
    SELECT member_total * 1.0 / SUM(member_total) OVER () AS share
    FROM member_sums
), averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(member_sums.member_total) AS total_amount,
    AVG(shares.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(shares.share - averages.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM member_sums
JOIN shares ON shares.share = member_sums.member_total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_total) FROM member_sums)
CROSS JOIN averages
WHERE shares.share > averages.avg_share;
